newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.00, 5.13 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 3-, 6-mo bills seen at 5.00, 5.13 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $26 billion in three- and six-month bills is expected to produce rates of 5.00 percent and 5.13 percent, respectively, dealers said on Monday.
"Today's three- and six-month auctions are expected to be uneventful, with demand getting hemmed in by the 2- and 5-year note auctions," said analysts at MMS International.
In when-issued trading before the 1300 EDT/1700 GMT bidding deadline, the three-month bills were at 5.005 percent while the six-month securities were at 5.125 percent.
